positive.prompt: Create the Linear project, milestone, cycle, and issues for this feature through the Linear MCP server
Reassign this Linear issue to the backend engineer and mark it blocked with a status update
Make a ticket for this request with my prompt verbatim before starting any work
File the review finding as a Linear issue and record on the ticket that the design review was skipped and why

negative.prompt: Write the PRD for this feature
Break this spec into small verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria

evals.prompt: The user says: "Add CSV export to the reports page, and skip the design review for this one." Set up the ticket in Linear.
evals.expected_output: A ticket searched for and then created under the right project before any code, carrying the user's prompt verbatim, the ticket anatomy, acceptance criteria, a scope class, the skipped design review recorded with the reason, and the identifier read back and quoted
expectations: Searches for an existing project and issue before creating
The ticket carries the user's prompt verbatim, not a paraphrase
